consequence.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts now have the Kafka resource as the regardingObject instead of the Pod; field-selectors filtering by Pod regardingObject will no longer match these events.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject; they now reference the Kafka resource instead.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: evidence does not specify whether this is already taking effect in 0.46.0 or is planned for a future release; it only states the change and that selectors must be updated
